webhooks.detail: No event-subscription/webhook API in reference. Only inbound automation trigger endpoint (POST /docs/{docId}/hooks/automation/{ruleId}) to fire a doc automation; no outbound events.

evidence.quote: This API allows you to trigger automations.

sandbox.detail: API available in free workspaces at no charge; sign up free and make an API token. No separate sandbox. createDoc needs Doc Maker/Admin role.

evidence.quote: We make the Superhuman Docs API available to all of our users free of charge, in both free and paid workspaces.

rate_limits.summary: Reads 100 req/6s; writes 10 req/6s; doc content writes 5 req/10s; listing docs 4 req/6s; HTTP 429 on exceed

evidence.quote: We do not currently support client libraries apart from Google Apps Script.
